name: Asphodelium
source:
Hazel is an ex-adventurer who's settled down with some of his previous guildmates after the adventure of a lifetime--taking down a doomsday cult that tried to end the world, but at the cost of killing their former guild leader who turned against them. Despite their adventure still haunting him months later, he's tried to move on.

That is until a man with the same face as their guild leader approaches him.

Asphodelium is a dark slice of life boys love story about your past confronting you. It's a story about what makes you, you. If you're not yourself, but you have your face, your memories, your mannerisms, then what is "you"?

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/asphodelium]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海泽尔是一名前冒险家，在经历了一生的冒险之后，他与一些以前的公会成员安定下来——推翻了一个试图终结世界的末日邪教，但代价是杀死了那些背叛他们的前公会领袖。尽管几个月后他们的冒险仍然困扰着他，但他试图继续前进。

直到一个与他们的公会会长有着相同面孔的男人走近了他。

《Aphodelium》是一个男孩爱情故事，讲述了你面对的过去的黑暗生活。这是一个关于是什么造就了你的故事。如果你不是你自己，但你有你的脸、你的记忆、你的举止，那么“你”是什么？

[来自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/asphodelium]itch.io[/url]]
